result.question: Quais são os 10 hospitais com mais de 1000 internações que nunca registraram nenhuma internação em UTI?
result.gold_sql: SELECT "CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes GROUP BY "CNES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 AND SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: SELECT "CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes GROUP BY "CNES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM internacoes d WHERE d."CNES" = internacoes."CNES" AND d."VAL_UTI" > 0 ) ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10;
